parsed_payload.reasoning: The hyperplanes x_i=x_j form the braid arrangement. Its chambers are the 5! = 120 regions corresponding to strict orderings of the coordinates. Fix any such ordering chamber C. For S=x_1+...+x_5, adding the same real number t to all coordinates preserves the ordering and changes S by 5t, so S takes every real value in C. Therefore the three hyperplanes S=-1,0,1 each meet C and cut it. Since C is convex and S is linear, the inequalities S<-1, -1<S<0, 0<S<1, S>1 define exactly four nonempty connected pieces of C. Thus each of the 120 braid chambers contributes exactly 4 regions after adding the sum hyperplanes. No regions are counted twice because different braid chambers are separated by some x_i=x_j. Hence the total number of regions is 120\cdot 4=480. \boxed{480}
